ps.en: When engineer Lin returned to her hometown, the [[local]] school was about to close its science lab for lack of funds. Her old teacher had treated teaching as something almost [[holy]], and Lin wanted to [[honor]] his memory with something more durable than a plaque. So she took the [[initiative]] and drafted a plan on the back of an envelope.
ps.zh: 工程师林回到家乡时，当地的学校正因经费不足打算关掉科学实验室。她的老教师生前把教书看得近乎神圣，林想用比一块牌匾更长久的东西来纪念他。于是她主动行动，在一个信封背面草拟了一份计划。

ps.en: Her idea was [[ingenious]] but simple: turn the flat, [[horizontal]] school roof into a greenhouse powered by solar panels. Every [[ingredient]] of the design — bamboo frames, recycled glass, rain barrels — could be found within the [[locality]], and the school, [[located|locate]] on a gentle hill, offered a perfect [[location]] with an open view of the [[horizon]].
ps.zh: 她的想法巧妙却简单：把学校平坦的水平屋顶改造成一座太阳能温室。设计所需的每一样材料——竹架、回收玻璃、雨水桶——都能在当地一带找到；而学校坐落在一座平缓的小山上，位置绝佳，眼前是开阔的地平线。

ps.en: The [[initial]] budget was tiny, so Lin [[initiated|initiate]] a weekend workshop where parents learned to build the frames themselves. Officials called her an [[honorable]] citizen; she called herself a lucky student. On opening day, children tasted tomatoes grown above their own classrooms, and the horizon suddenly looked much closer.
ps.zh: 最初的预算少得可怜，于是林发起了一个周末工坊，让家长们自己动手学搭竹架。官员们称她为可敬的市民；她只说自己是个幸运的学生。开放日那天，孩子们尝到了长在自家教室头顶的番茄，地平线忽然显得近了许多。

ps.en: Dr. Su had [[presided|preside]] over the community clinic for fifteen years, and her [[prestige]] rested on one rule: never [[neglect]] a small symptom. A [[previous]] chief had once treated a strange cough as [[negligible]], and the town had not forgotten what followed.
ps.zh: 苏医生主持这家社区诊所已有十五年，她的声望建立在一条准则上：绝不忽视任何一个小症状。前任主任曾把一种怪咳当作微不足道的小事，而镇上的人至今没有忘记后来发生的事。

ps.en: So when a strange fever appeared, she did not [[presume]] it would pass, though officials [[presumably]] hoped she would stay quiet. Reporters filled the little waiting room — the [[press]] loves a crisis — and their very [[presence]] put the clinic under enormous [[pressure]]. At [[present]], she told them, the real danger was rumor, not the virus; fear could [[prey]] on the elderly faster than any infection. The vaccine would arrive [[presently]], she promised.
ps.zh: 所以当一种怪热病出现时，她没有想当然地以为它会自己过去，尽管官员们想必希望她保持沉默。记者挤满了小小的候诊室——新闻界最爱危机——单是他们在场，就给诊所带来了巨大的压力。她告诉记者们，目前真正的危险是谣言，而不是病毒；恐惧侵害老年人的速度，比任何感染都快。她保证，疫苗很快就会送到。

ps.en: She [[prescribed|prescribe]] rest and clean water before she wrote a single [[prescription]], insisting that cheap habits [[prevent]] more illness than expensive drugs. To [[preserve]] public trust, she presented every figure she had, day after day. The fever faded within a month, and for a while the reporters became unpaid health educators.
ps.zh: 在开出任何一张处方之前，她先嘱咐人们休息、喝干净的水，因为她坚信，廉价的习惯比昂贵的药物能预防更多疾病。为了维护公众的信任，她日复一日地公布手头所有数据。一个月后热病消退，而那些记者一度成了不领薪水的健康教育员。

ps.en: For six years Mei had been the company's most [[reliable]] translator, the one who could turn a messy [[transaction]] into [[straightforward]] English overnight. Her [[strategy]] was simple: be [[straight]] with clients, never guess at a meaning, and [[rely]] on dictionaries the way sailors rely on stars.
ps.zh: 六年来，梅是公司里最可靠的译员，能把一笔乱糟糟的交易连夜译成简明易懂的英文。她的策略很简单：对客户坦诚，绝不瞎猜词义，像水手信赖星星一样信赖词典。

ps.en: Then the firm asked her to do a [[translation]] of old [[religious]] poems for a museum — a task where [[religion]], memory and music all met. The work put an unfamiliar [[strain]] on her; she made [[strenuous]] efforts night after night and tested every line with a retired monk, whose quiet [[strength]] [[strengthened|strengthen]] her own. Business English had taught her that meaning could be [[transferred|transfer]] like money; poetry taught her otherwise.
ps.zh: 后来公司请她为一家博物馆翻译古老的宗教诗歌——在那里，宗教、记忆与音乐交汇。这项工作给她带来了前所未有的负担；她夜夜苦熬，把每一行都拿去向一位还俗的老僧请教，老僧身上那种沉静的力量也增强了她的力量。商务英语曾教她：意义可以像钱一样被转递；诗歌却告诉她并非如此。

ps.en: When the exhibition opened, visitors said the English lines seemed to [[transform]] the room. One critic called her gift anything but [[transient]]. Mei only smiled: her real [[reliance]] had never been talent, but the plain habit of honest work.
ps.zh: 展览开幕时，观众说那些英文诗句仿佛改变了整个展厅。一位评论家称她的才华绝非转瞬即逝之物。梅只是笑笑：她真正的依靠从来不是天赋，而是老老实实做事的习惯。

ps.en: When the town announced a competition to redesign its old market [[area]], the retired [[architect]] Gao was the first to enter. He spent weeks in the city [[archive]], where a whole [[array]] of [[vivid]] photographs showed what the square had once been — an [[arena]] of public life, not just a place to buy vegetables.
ps.zh: 镇里宣布要为老集市区域的改造方案征集设计时，退休建筑师高第一个报了名。他在市档案馆泡了好几个星期，那里一大批生动的老照片告诉他，这片广场曾经是什么模样——那是公共生活的舞台，而不只是个买菜的地方。

ps.en: Many residents began to [[argue]] that a shrinking town needed parking lots, not [[architecture]]. Gao's [[argument]] was that the [[void]] in the town was not economic but emotional: people no longer had a reason to meet. Questions [[arose|arise]] about cost, and they [[aroused|arouse]] real anger at a public meeting.
ps.zh: 许多居民开始争论：一个不断收缩的小镇需要的是停车场，而不是建筑。高的论点是：镇上的空白不在经济，而在情感——人们已经没有一个相聚的理由。关于造价的质疑冒了出来，并在一次公众见面会上激起了真正的怒火。

ps.en: His answer was [[visual]] and concrete — a model of a glass hall whose most [[visible]] wall would hold [[volumes|volume]] of local history, open to everyone. A library, he said, is [[vital]] in the way a heart is vital; his [[vision]] was simply a room where the town could recognize itself. He did not win the competition, but three years later the winning design looked very much like his.
ps.zh: 他的回答直观而具体——一座玻璃大厅的模型，最显眼的那面墙将陈列着本地历史的一册册典籍，向所有人开放。他说，图书馆之于小镇，恰如心脏之于身体，至关重要；他的愿景不过是一个让小镇认出自己的房间。他没有赢得竞赛，但三年后，中标方案看上去与他的作品惊人地相似。

ps.en: The [[dispute]] over the river began when the paper mill doubled its water [[consumption]]. Farmers downstream saw the [[consequence]] within weeks — [[considerable]] stretches of dry riverbed — and [[consequently]] blamed the mill for every dead fish, while the mill blamed the drought.
ps.zh: 这场关于河流的争端，始于造纸厂把用水量翻了一倍。下游的农民几周内就看到了后果——河床大片大片地干涸——于是把每一条死鱼都算在纸厂头上，纸厂则把一切归咎于干旱。

ps.en: The older farmers were [[conservative]] by habit and distrusted talk of [[conservation]], which sounded to them like a city fashion. The mill owners, for their part, treated the river as their [[exclusive]] resource and tried to [[exclude]] the villages from the negotiation. A young mediator asked both sides to [[consider]] one plain fact: people [[consume]] a river together, whether they admit it or not.
ps.zh: 年长的农民习性守旧，不信任所谓水源保护的说法，觉得那是城里人的时髦。厂主们则把河流当作自己独享的资源，想把各村排除在谈判之外。一位年轻的调解人请双方正视一个朴素的事实：一条河是被所有人共同消耗的，无论他们承认与否。

ps.en: She persuaded them to [[exchange]] their data in public, not behind the doors of some exclusive club of experts. The solution, when it came, was surprisingly [[considerate]]: the mill would recycle its water, and the farmers would take turns in the dry season. The old hostility did not vanish, but it began to [[dissolve]] the way salt dissolves — slowly, invisibly, and for good.
ps.zh: 她说服双方公开交换各自的数据，而不是躲进某个专家专享的密室。最终的方案出人意料地周到：纸厂循环用水，农民们在旱季轮流取水。旧日的敌意没有消失，但它开始像盐一样溶解——缓慢地、无声地、彻底地。

c: a holy place 圣地
a holy war 圣战
the Holy Bible 圣经
words.dif: holy 是「神圣的」；holiday 源自 holy day，如今只指「假日」，二者已无词义关联
words.pat: For her, teaching was not a job but something holy.
words.patZh: 对她而言，教书不是一份职业，而是一件神圣的事。

words.exam: 尊敬；敬意；荣誉；光荣；给以荣誉
c: in honor of 为纪念，为向…表示敬意
have the honor of doing 有幸做
do honor to sb 向…致敬
words.dif: in honor of 表「为纪念」；on one's honor 表「以名誉担保」，语境别混
words.pat: A monument was built in honor of those who had served the community.
words.patZh: 人们立碑纪念那些为社区服务过的人。

words.exam: 可敬的；高尚的；荣誉的，光荣的
c: an honorable man 正派人
an honorable profession 高尚的职业
an honorable mention 荣誉提名
fam: honor n./v. → honorable adj. → honorably adv.
words.dif: honorable 是「值得尊敬的」；honorary 是「荣誉性质的、挂名的」，如 honorary degree 荣誉学位
words.pat: Winning is less important than being an honorable competitor.
words.patZh: 做一个光明磊落的竞争者，比获胜更重要。

words.exam: 地平线；（知识、思想、经验等的）范围，眼界，见识
c: on the horizon 即将出现
broaden / widen one's horizons 开阔眼界
a new horizon 新天地
words.dif: horizon 常用复数 horizons 表「眼界」；horizontal 是形容词「水平的」，形近义不同
words.pat: Travel is one of the best ways to broaden one's horizons.
words.patZh: 旅行是开阔眼界的最佳方式之一。

c: a horizontal line 水平线
horizontal expansion 横向扩张
horizontal communication 横向沟通
fam: horizon n. 地平线 → horizontal adj.
words.dif: horizontal（横向的）与 vertical（纵向的）成对，写作对比好用
words.pat: Horizontal communication between departments matters as much as top-down orders.
words.patZh: 部门之间的横向沟通与自上而下的命令同样重要。

words.exam: （人、头脑）灵巧的，机灵的；（主意等）别出心裁的，巧妙的
c: an ingenious idea 巧妙的主意
an ingenious device 精巧的装置
an ingenious way of doing sth 做…的巧妙办法
words.dif: ingenious 是「机灵的、巧妙的」（褒义）；ingenuous 是「天真坦率的」，只差一个字母，极易混
words.pat: An ingenious solution often costs less than a powerful one.
words.patZh: 巧妙的方案往往比强力的方案成本更低。

c: the ingredients of sth …的成分
a key ingredient in …的关键要素
natural ingredients 天然成分
fam: ingredient n.（in- 入 + gredi 走，无常用同根派生）
words.dif: ingredient 既可指「食材原料」也可喻指「成功要素」；component 偏机械、系统部件
words.pat: Trust is an essential ingredient of any lasting cooperation.
words.patZh: 信任是一切持久合作的必备要素。

words.exam: 最初的；开始的；（名字的）首字母
c: the initial stage 初始阶段
initial investment 初期投入
initials 首字母（复数）
words.dif: initial 只作定语修饰名词（the initial plan）；originally 是副词，别拿 initial 当副词用
words.pat: The initial response to the policy was far from enthusiastic.
words.patZh: 这项政策最初得到的反应远谈不上热烈。

c: initiate a project 发起项目
initiate reform 启动改革
initiate sb into 使某人初步了解
fam: initial adj. → initiate v. → initiative n.
words.dif: initiate 是及物动词，正式用词，强调「由某人启动」；start 最通用
words.pat: Local governments should initiate programs that truly answer people's needs.
words.patZh: 地方政府应发起真正回应民众需求的项目。

words.exam: 主动性（权）；进取心；倡议，新方案
c: take the initiative 采取主动
on one's own initiative 主动地
a peace initiative 和平倡议
words.dif: take the initiative 后接 in doing sth，不接 to do，这是完形高频陷阱
words.pat: Those who take the initiative in learning rarely need to be pushed.
words.patZh: 主动学习的人很少需要别人催促。

c: local government 地方政府
local residents 当地居民
a local anaesthetic 局部麻醉
words.dif: local 指「当地的」；locate 是动词「位于」；locality 是名词「地点」，词性别混
words.pat: The campaign won strong support from local businesses.
words.patZh: 这场活动赢得了当地商家的大力支持。

c: in the locality 在当地
the whole locality 整个地区
a safe locality 安全的区域
words.dif: locality 是正式用词，指「某地点及周边一带」；location 最常用，指具体位置
words.pat: Living standards vary greatly from one locality to another.
words.patZh: 不同地区的生活水平差异很大。

words.exam: 指出（地点或位置）；使坐落于，位于
c: be located in / on 坐落于
locate the source of 查明…的来源
locate sth on a map 在地图上定位
words.dif: 「坐落于」必须用被动 be located in；主动 locate sth 是「找到…的位置」
words.pat: The new campus is located on the edge of the city.
words.patZh: 新校区坐落在城市边缘。

c: a prime location 黄金地段
on location 在外景地
the location of …的位置
words.dif: location 强调「具体坐落点」；position 强调「相对位置、方位」
words.pat: The success of a shop depends largely on its location.
words.patZh: 一家店的成败很大程度上取决于地段。

c: neglect one's duty 玩忽职守
neglect to do sth 忘了做
fall into neglect 被荒废
words.dif: neglect 强调「因疏忽而未做」；ignore 是「明知故不理」；overlook 是「没注意到」
words.pat: Those who neglect small problems often end up facing big ones.
words.patZh: 忽视小问题的人，往往终将被大问题缠上。

c: a negligible amount 微乎其微的量
negligible risk 极小的风险
far from negligible 绝非小事
words.dif: negligible 是「小到可以忽略」；neglectful 是「（人）疏忽的」，别用 negligible 形容人
words.pat: The cost of prevention is negligible compared with the cost of a cure.
words.patZh: 与治疗的代价相比，预防的成本微不足道。

c: prescribe medicine for 为…开药
as prescribed 按规定；按医嘱
prescribe sth to sb 给…开（药）
words.dif: prescribe 是「开处方 / 规定」；proscribe 是「禁止」，一字之差，意思相反
words.pat: Doctors should prescribe fewer drugs and more patience.
words.patZh: 医生应当少开些药，多给些耐心。

c: write a prescription 开处方
fill a prescription 按方抓药
a prescription for 解决…的良方
words.dif: prescription 是「处方」；description 是「描述」，形近易混，阅读里常设干扰
words.pat: A good prescription for stress is regular exercise and enough sleep.
words.patZh: 对付压力的良方是规律运动和充足睡眠。

c: in the presence of 当着…的面
one's presence at 出席
make one's presence felt 让人感觉到存在
words.dif: presence 是「在场」；present 作形容词是「出席的 / 现在的」，作名词是「礼物 / 现在」
words.pat: The mere presence of a good listener can ease a person's anxiety.
words.patZh: 只要有一位好的倾听者在场，就能缓解一个人的焦虑。

words.exam: 给予；呈现；现在的；目前的；现在；礼品
c: at present 目前
present sth to sb 把…递交给
present an opportunity 提供机会
the present situation 现状
words.dif: 作动词重音在后 preˈsent，作名词、形容词重音在前 ˈpresent，义随音变
words.pat: At present, no single measure can solve the problem overnight.
words.patZh: 目前没有任何单一措施能一夜之间解决问题。

c: arrive presently 很快到达
presently working as 目前从事
until presently 直到不久以后
fam: present → presently n. 相关延伸
words.dif: presently 在正式文体中多表「不久」，在口语中常表「现在」，阅读时要靠语境判断
words.pat: The results of the survey will be published presently.
words.patZh: 调查结果很快就会公布。

words.exam: 保护；保存；（某群体）专有的活动
c: preserve the environment 保护环境
preserve one's dignity 保全尊严
preserve food 保存食物
words.dif: preserve 强调「保持原样不受损」；reserve 是「预留、保留」；conserve 是「节约使用、保护（资源）」
words.pat: It takes effort to preserve trust, but only a moment to destroy it.
words.patZh: 维护信任需要长久的努力，毁掉它却只在一瞬间。

c: preside over a meeting 主持会议
preside over 主管，掌管
preside at 主持（仪式）
words.dif: preside 是不及物动词，必须接 over / at；「主持会议」不能说 preside a meeting
words.pat: Whoever presides over a discussion should let every voice be heard.
words.patZh: 主持讨论的人，应当让每种声音都被听见。

words.exam: 报刊；新闻界；出版社；按，压；催促，逼迫
c: the press 新闻界（集合名词）
a press conference 记者招待会
press for 敦促，迫切要求
press a button 按按钮
fam: impress v. 留下印象（同根）
words.dif: the press 指「新闻界」整体；a press 是「印刷机 / 按压」，单复数含义不同
words.pat: A free press is widely seen as a safeguard of democracy.
words.patZh: 新闻自由被广泛视为民主的保障。

c: under pressure 在压力下
put pressure on sb 向…施压
peer pressure 同辈压力
relieve pressure 缓解压力
words.dif: pressure 泛指「压力」；stress 偏「精神紧绷」；strain 偏「超负荷的劳损」，三词常一起设选项
words.pat: Young people today face pressure from both work and family.
words.patZh: 如今年轻人承受着来自工作与家庭的双重压力。

c: enjoy high prestige 享有崇高声望
a matter of prestige 面子问题
gain / lose prestige 赢得 / 丧失威信
words.dif: prestige 是不可数名词，泛指「声望」；reputation 可数，指「具体的名声」，可有好坏
words.pat: Prestige built over decades can be lost in a single scandal.
words.patZh: 数十年积累的声望，可能毁于一桩丑闻。

c: presumably he will 想必他会
presumably because 大概因为
presumably true 大概属实
words.dif: presumably 基于合理推测「想必」；supposedly 暗含怀疑「据说（未必可信）」
words.pat: Presumably, the delay was caused by the heavy rain.
words.patZh: 延误想必是大雨造成的。

words.exam: 推测；假定，假设；认为，推定
c: presume that... 假定
be presumed innocent 被推定无罪
presume on 滥用，指望
words.dif: presume 强调「有依据地推定」，法律味浓；assume 是「想当然地认为」，依据最弱
words.pat: We should not presume that silence means agreement.
words.patZh: 我们不该想当然地认为沉默就是同意。

c: prevent sb (from) doing 阻止…做
prevent disease 预防疾病
prevent accidents 防止事故
words.dif: prevent sb doing 中的 from 可省略；但 prohibit 必须用 prohibit sb from doing，不能省
words.pat: It is always easier to prevent a problem than to fix it.
words.patZh: 预防问题总比事后补救容易。

c: the previous year 前一年
previous experience 以往经验
previous to 在…之前（正式）
words.dif: previous 泛指「此前的」；former 与 latter 配对，指「前者的」；prior 更正式，常接 to
words.pat: Each generation builds on the achievements of the previous one.
words.patZh: 每一代人都在前一代人的成就之上继续建设。

words.exam: 被捕食的动物，捕获物；受损害者，牺牲品；捕食；掠夺
c: prey on / upon 捕食；坑害
fall prey to 沦为…的牺牲品
a bird of prey 猛禽
words.dif: prey on 既可指「动物捕食」也可喻指「坑害弱者」；fall prey to 后接「坏事物」，是阅读高频搭配
words.pat: Online fraud often makes the elderly fall prey to well-designed lies.
words.patZh: 网络诈骗常让老年人沦为精心设计的谎言的牺牲品。

c: a reliable source 可靠来源
reliable data 可靠数据
a reliable friend 靠得住的朋友
fam: rely v. → reliable adj. → reliability n. 可靠性
words.dif: reliable 形容「人或物靠得住」；creditable 是「值得称赞的」，形近义远
words.pat: Sound judgment must be based on reliable information.
words.patZh: 可靠的判断必须建立在可靠的信息之上。

c: reliance on 对…的依赖
place reliance on 信赖
self-reliance 自力更生
fam: rely v. → reliance n. → reliable adj.
words.dif: reliance 与 dependence 都表「依赖」，reliance 偏主动信任，dependence 偏「依附、离不开」
words.pat: Excessive reliance on technology may weaken our own abilities.
words.patZh: 过度依赖技术可能削弱我们自身的能力。

c: freedom of religion 宗教自由
an organized religion 有组织的宗教
make a religion of 把…当作信条
words.dif: religion 指「宗教（体系）」；faith 可泛指「信念、信心」，范围更广
words.pat: For some people, hard work is almost a religion.
words.patZh: 对有些人来说，努力工作几乎成了一种信仰。

c: religious belief 宗教信仰
a religious ceremony 宗教仪式
religious art 宗教艺术
fam: religion n. → religious adj. → religiously adv.
words.dif: religious 形容「与宗教有关的」；spiritual 偏「精神层面的」，不一定涉宗教
words.pat: The museum keeps a fine collection of religious art.
words.patZh: 这座博物馆收藏了一批精美的宗教艺术品。

c: rely on / upon 依靠，信赖
rely on sb to do 指望某人做
rely on it that... 放心好了
words.dif: rely on 含「信任」意味；depend on 偏「客观依附」；count on 偏口语「指望」
words.pat: A team succeeds only when its members can rely on one another.
words.patZh: 只有成员彼此信赖，团队才能成功。

words.exam: 直的，笔直的；正直的；直接地，直率地
c: go straight 一直走
be straight with sb 对…坦诚
a straight answer 直截了当的回答
straight away 立刻
fam: straightforward adj. 直率的；简单的
words.dif: straight 是「直的」；strait 是「海峡 / 困境」，同音异义，拼写陷阱
words.pat: A straight answer is always better than a clever excuse.
words.patZh: 坦率的回答永远好过巧妙的借口。

words.exam: 正直的，坦率的；简单的，易懂的
c: a straightforward task 简单的任务
be straightforward with 对…坦率
straightforward instructions 简明的说明
fam: straight + forward（合成词） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: straightforward 既表「（事）简单」又表「（人）坦率」；simple 只表事，frank 只表人
words.pat: Good writing is straightforward: it says what it means.
words.patZh: 好的写作是直截了当的：想说什么就说什么。

words.exam: 使紧张；拉紧，绷紧；使损伤，使过劳；拉力，张力；极度紧张；损伤，劳损
c: under strain 在压力下
a strain on 对…的负担
strain one's eyes 损伤视力
physical strain 身体劳损
words.dif: strain 强调「超负荷造成的紧张与损伤」；stress 偏心理压力；tension 偏关系或局势的紧张
words.pat: Long working hours put a heavy strain on family life.
words.patZh: 长时间工作给家庭生活带来了沉重的负担。

c: a strategy for doing 做…的策略
adopt a strategy 采取策略
long-term strategy 长期战略
words.dif: strategy 是「全局性战略」；tactic 是「具体战术」，一大一小，写作对比常用
words.pat: The best strategy for learning a language is steady daily practice.
words.patZh: 学习语言的最佳策略是稳定的每日练习。

words.exam: 力量，力气；实力；活力，效力
c: build up one's strength 增强体力
strengths and weaknesses 优缺点
a position of strength 实力地位
fam: strong adj. → strength n. → strengthen v.
words.dif: strength 作「优点」讲时与 weakness 相对，是完形高频义项，别只记「力气」
words.pat: Knowing one's own strength is the beginning of wisdom.
words.patZh: 了解自己的长处，是智慧的开端。

c: strengthen ties 加强联系
strengthen one's confidence 增强信心
strengthen cooperation 加强合作
fam: strong → strength → strengthen n. 相关延伸
words.dif: strengthen 是「使变强」，拼写是 strength + en，多写一个 h（strenghten）是常见错误
words.pat: Shared hardship tends to strengthen the bond between people.
words.patZh: 共患难往往会加深人与人之间的纽带。

words.exam: 努力的；奋力的；顽强的；艰辛的，费力的
c: strenuous efforts 艰苦努力
a strenuous workout 高强度锻炼
strenuous opposition 顽强反对
words.dif: strenuous 强调「费劲的、需要拼命的」；vigorous 强调「充满活力的」，色彩不同
words.pat: Success rarely comes without strenuous and sustained effort.
words.patZh: 不付出艰辛而持久的努力，很难获得成功。

c: business transactions 商业交易
conduct a transaction 进行交易
online transactions 网上交易
fam: trans（横跨）+ act（行动） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: transaction 指「一笔正式交易 / 事务办理」；deal 更口语；transmission 是「传送」，形近勿混
words.pat: Every online transaction leaves a digital footprint.
words.patZh: 每一笔网上交易都会留下数字痕迹。

words.exam: 转移；调动；转让，让与；转变
c: transfer from... to... 从…转到
transfer money 转账
transfer to another department 调动部门
words.dif: transfer 是「转移 / 调动」；transform 是「彻底改变形态」，程度完全不同
words.pat: Technology makes it easy to transfer both money and ideas across borders.
words.patZh: 技术让资金与观念都能轻松跨越国界。

c: transform... into... 把…变成
transform one's life 改变人生
transform the economy 改造经济
words.dif: transform 强调「形态、性质的根本改变」；transfer 只是「位置移动」，考试常拿来对比
words.pat: Education has the power to transform not only minds but whole communities.
words.patZh: 教育的力量不仅能改变人的思想，还能改变整个社区。

words.exam: 短暂的；转瞬即逝的；临时的
c: transient fame 短暂的名声
a transient population 流动人口
transient joy 转瞬即逝的快乐
fam: transit n. 运输，经过（同根）
words.dif: transient 是书面语「转瞬即逝的」；temporary 是通用词「暂时的」；permanent 是其反义
words.pat: Material pleasures are often transient, while knowledge endures.
words.patZh: 物质的快乐往往转瞬即逝，知识却能长存。

c: in translation 经翻译后
a literal translation 直译
lost in translation 在翻译中流失
fam: translate v. → translation n. → translator n. 译者
words.dif: translation 多指「笔译」；interpretation 多指「口译」，招聘与新闻里常按此区分
words.pat: Much of a poem's music is lost in translation.
words.patZh: 诗歌的韵律大多会在翻译中流失。

words.exam: 建筑师；设计师；缔造者，创造者
c: a chief architect 总设计师
the architect of …的缔造者
a landscape architect 景观设计师
words.dif: architect 常喻指「（计划、事业的）缔造者」，如 the architect of reform，是阅读常见比喻义
words.pat: Every person is the architect of his own future.
words.patZh: 每个人都是自己未来的设计师。

words.exam: 建筑学，建筑术；建筑风格，建筑式样；结构
c: modern architecture 现代建筑
Gothic architecture 哥特式建筑
the architecture of a system 系统架构
words.dif: architecture 可指「建筑风格」也可喻指「（系统、组织的）架构」，科技类阅读常取后者
words.pat: Good architecture shapes not only cities but also the way people live.
words.patZh: 好的建筑不仅塑造城市，也塑造人们的生活方式。

words.exam: 档案；档案馆，档案室；把…存档，归档
c: the national archives 国家档案馆
archive the documents 把文件存档
keep in the archives 存入档案
words.dif: archive 是可数的「档案（馆）」，作动词是「存档」；file 偏日常「文件、卷宗」
words.pat: Old newspapers in the archive tell us how people once lived.
words.patZh: 档案馆里的旧报纸告诉我们前人如何生活。

c: in the area of 在…领域
a rural area 农村地区
a parking area 停车区
fam: area n.（源自拉丁语「空地」，无常用同根派生）
words.dif: area 是通用词「地区 / 领域」；region 偏「较大行政区或自然区域」；zone 偏「功能划定的地带」
words.pat: The government plans to turn the old industrial area into a park.
words.patZh: 政府计划把这片老工业区改造成公园。

words.exam: 圆形运动场，圆形剧场；竞争舞台，活动场所
c: the political arena 政治舞台
enter the arena 登上舞台
a sports arena 体育场
fam: arena n.（源自拉丁语「沙地」，指古罗马竞技场）
words.dif: arena 本义「竞技场」，今多喻指「竞争、博弈的舞台」，比 stage 更带对抗味
words.pat: The Internet has become a new arena for public debate.
words.patZh: 互联网已成为公共辩论的新舞台。

c: argue with sb 与…争论
argue about / over 争论某事
argue that... 主张
argue for / against 主张支持 / 反对
words.dif: argue 除「争吵」外更常考「主张、论证」（argue that...），阅读里多取此义
words.pat: Some argue that competition does more harm than cooperation.
words.patZh: 有人主张，竞争的害处大于合作。

c: an argument for / against 支持 / 反对…的论据
put forward an argument 提出论点
get into an argument 发生争吵
words.dif: argument 表「论点」时可数、中性；表「争吵」时偏口语；reason 只表「理由」
words.pat: A convincing argument rests on facts rather than loud words.
words.patZh: 有说服力的论点依靠事实，而非高分贝的言辞。

words.exam: 产生，出现；上升，升起；起立，起身
c: arise from / out of 由…引起
problems arise 问题出现
arise from a misunderstanding 源于误解
fam: 不规则动词：arise - arose - arisen n. 相关延伸
words.dif: arise（产生）是不规则动词 arise-arose-arisen；arouse（激起）是规则动词，拼写差一个字母
words.pat: New opportunities often arise from unexpected difficulties.
words.patZh: 新机遇常常在意想不到的困境中产生。

c: arouse interest 引起兴趣
arouse anger 激起愤怒
arouse suspicion 引起怀疑
words.dif: arouse 是「激起（情绪、兴趣）」，及物；arise 是「（问题）出现」，不及物，词性别混
words.pat: Good teachers know how to arouse students' curiosity.
words.patZh: 好老师懂得怎样激发学生的好奇心。

words.exam: 一系列，大量；排列，队形；部署（兵力）；穿着，打扮
c: an array of 一大批，一系列
a vast array of 种类繁多的
an impressive array 令人赞叹的一批
fam: array v./n.（名动同形，源自古法语）
words.dif: an array of 强调「琳琅满目的一大排」，比 a lot of 更有画面感，是写作升级好词
words.pat: The library offers an impressive array of digital resources.
words.patZh: 这座图书馆提供了一大批令人印象深刻的数字资源。

words.exam: 看得见的，可见的；明显的，有形的
c: visible to the naked eye 肉眼可见
a visible change 明显的变化
highly visible 引人注目的
words.dif: visible 是「看得见」；visual 是「视觉的」；vision 是「视力 / 愿景」，三词同源不同性
words.pat: The benefits of the policy were visible within a single year.
words.patZh: 这项政策的成效一年之内便清晰可见。

words.exam: 视力，视觉；想象，幻想；目光，眼力
c: a vision of 对…的构想
beyond one's vision 超出眼界
have the vision to do 有做…的远见
words.dif: vision 常考比喻义「远见、愿景」；eyesight 只指「视力」；view 是「看法 / 风景」
words.pat: Great leaders turn a personal vision into a shared cause.
words.patZh: 伟大的领导者能把个人愿景变成众人共同的事业。

c: visual aids 直观教具
visual arts 视觉艺术
a visual learner 视觉型学习者
words.dif: visual 是形容词「视觉的」；visible 是「能被看见的」，一个是感觉通道，一个是能否被感知
words.pat: Charts and maps are powerful visual tools in a presentation.
words.patZh: 图表和地图是演示中强有力的直观工具。

words.exam: （有）生命力的；极其重要的；致命的
c: be vital to / for 对…至关重要
a vital role 关键作用
vital signs 生命体征
words.dif: vital 强调「关乎存亡、不可或缺」；important 是通用词；crucial 强调「决定性的关键时刻」
words.pat: Clean water is vital to the health of any community.
words.patZh: 洁净的水对任何社区的健康都至关重要。

words.exam: 鲜艳的；生动的，栩栩如生的
c: a vivid description 生动的描述
vivid memories 鲜明的记忆
vivid colors 鲜艳的色彩
words.dif: vivid 强调「（记忆、描写）如在眼前」；alive 强调「活着的」；lively 强调「活泼的」
words.pat: The novel gives a vivid picture of life in a small town.
words.patZh: 这部小说生动描绘了小镇生活的图景。

words.exam: 空的；（of）无效的；没有的，缺乏的
c: fill a void 填补空白
null and void （法律）无效的
be void of 缺乏
words.dif: void 作名词是「空白、空虚」；作形容词「无效的」多用于法律（null and void）；vacant 指「（职位、座位）空着的」
words.pat: The new library filled a long-standing void in the town's cultural life.
words.patZh: 新图书馆填补了该镇文化生活中长期存在的空白。

words.exam: 容积，体积；卷，册；音量，响度
c: volumes of 大量的；一册册
the volume of trade 贸易量
turn up the volume 调大音量
words.dif: volume 常考引申义「（贸易、数据的）总量」，别只记「一卷书」；sales volume 是高频商业搭配
words.pat: The volume of online information doubles almost every year.
words.patZh: 网络信息的总量几乎每年翻一番。

c: as a consequence 因此
face the consequences 承担后果
of little consequence 无关紧要
words.dif: consequence 多指「不良后果」；result 是中性「结果」；outcome 指「最终结局」
words.pat: Every choice carries its own consequences, welcome or not.
words.patZh: 每个选择都自带后果，无论你欢迎与否。

c: consequently, ... 因此…
and consequently 因此
consequently fail to 因而未能
words.dif: consequently 是副词，不能当连词直接连两个分句，需加句号或 and；therefore 同此理
words.pat: The bridge was closed, and consequently traffic was diverted to the old road.
words.patZh: 大桥封闭了，因此车辆被分流到老路上。

c: energy conservation 节能
wildlife conservation 野生动物保护
environmental conservation 环境保护
fam: conserve v. 节约，保护 → conservation n.
words.dif: conservation 是「（资源、环境的）保护与节约」；conversation 是「谈话」，形近最易混
words.pat: Conservation begins with the small choices we make every day.
words.patZh: 资源与环境的保护始于我们每天做的小选择。

words.exam: 保守的，守旧的；保守主义者
c: conservative views 保守观点
a conservative estimate 保守估计
the Conservative Party （英）保守党
fam: conserve v. → conservation n. → conservative adj./n.
words.dif: a conservative estimate 是「保守的、偏低的估计」，与政治立场无关，是阅读常考搭配
words.pat: A conservative approach may miss opportunities but also avoids disasters.
words.patZh: 保守的做法或许会错失机会，但也能避开灾难。

words.exam: 考虑，细想；认为，把…看做；体贴，关心
c: consider doing 考虑做（不接 to do）
consider sb (to be) 认为…是
all things considered 通盘考虑
words.dif: consider 后接动名词不接不定式；「考虑做」是 consider doing，这是高频语法考点
words.pat: Before we judge others, we should consider their circumstances.
words.patZh: 评判他人之前，我们应当先考虑他们的处境。

c: considerable damage 巨大损失
a considerable amount of 大量的
considerable influence 可观的影响力
fam: consider v. → considerable adj. → considerably adv.
words.dif: considerable 是「大量的」；considerate 是「体贴的」，只差两个字母，意思风马牛不相及
words.pat: The project has attracted considerable public attention.
words.patZh: 这个项目吸引了公众相当大的关注。

c: be considerate of / towards 体谅
a considerate host 周到的主人
it is considerate of sb to do 某人做…真体贴
words.dif: considerate 是「体贴他人的」；considerable 是「数量可观的」，完形常把两者放同一选项组
words.pat: Being considerate of others costs little but earns much.
words.patZh: 体谅他人代价很小，收获却很大。

c: consume energy 消耗能源
time-consuming 费时的
be consumed with 被（情感）吞噬
words.dif: consume 是正式用词「消耗」；use up 是口语「用完」；consumer 是其派生「消费者」
words.pat: Modern lifestyles consume far more resources than the planet can renew.
words.patZh: 现代生活方式消耗的资源远超地球的再生能力。

c: energy consumption 能耗
mass consumption 大众消费
consumption patterns 消费模式
fam: consume v. → consumption n. → consumer n.
words.dif: consumption 是「消费、消耗（名词）」；assumption 是「假设」，形近易混，阅读常设干扰
words.pat: Reducing consumption is as important as finding new resources.
words.patZh: 减少消耗与寻找新资源同等重要。

c: in dispute 有争议
settle a dispute 解决争端
beyond dispute 无可争辩
a labor dispute 劳资纠纷
words.dif: dispute 可作名词「争端」也可作动词「质疑、争论」（dispute sth）；debate 偏正式辩论
words.pat: The facts of the case are beyond dispute; only their meaning is argued over.
words.patZh: 案件的事实无可争辩，有争议的只是对事实的解读。

words.exam: 溶解，融化；使溶解；解散，取消
c: dissolve in water 溶于水
dissolve parliament 解散议会
dissolve a partnership 解除合伙关系
fam: solution n. 溶液；解决办法（同根 solv- 松开）
words.dif: dissolve 是「（固体）溶解 / （组织）解散」；resolve 是「解决（问题）」；solve 是「解（题）」，同源三词常对比
words.pat: Mutual trust can dissolve suspicions that logic cannot touch.
words.patZh: 相互信任能化解逻辑触及不到的猜疑。

words.exam: 交换，调换，兑换；交流，交易；交易所
c: exchange... for... 以…换
exchange ideas 交流想法
in exchange for 作为…的交换
foreign exchange 外汇
words.dif: exchange A for B 是「用 A 换 B」；exchange A with B 是「与 B 互换 A」，介词决定方向
words.pat: An open exchange of views is the first step toward agreement.
words.patZh: 坦诚交换意见是达成共识的第一步。

c: exclude sb from 把…排除在…之外
exclude the possibility 排除可能性
excluding 不包括（介词）
words.dif: exclude 与 include 是反义对；excluding（不含）与 including（含）常在账单、条款里成对出现
words.pat: No one should be excluded from education because of poverty.
words.patZh: 任何人都不应因贫穷而被排除在教育之外。

words.exam: 专有的，独占的；排他的；高档的；独家新闻
c: exclusive rights 专有权
an exclusive interview 独家专访
exclusive of 不包括（正式）
an exclusive club 门槛极高的俱乐部
fam: exclude v. → exclusive adj. → exclusively adv. 仅仅
words.dif: exclusive 是「排他的、独家的」；inclusive 是「包容的」；exclusive of 表「不包括」，与 inclusive of 相反
words.pat: Quality education should not be the exclusive privilege of the rich.
words.patZh: 优质教育不应是富人独享的特权。
